prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP server in JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 introduces a general acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header into media-range entries and correctly excludes entries with q=0 (explicitly-rejected types) and handles type/subtype wildcard matching. #2046 instead does a plain `acceptHeader.includes('application/json')` substring check, which does not honor q=0 exclusion or wildcard Accept values (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would incorrectly still be treated as accepted). #1996's helper is also reusable for the text/event-stream check in the same file, whereas #2046's fix is a one-off inline change.

clusters.pick_reason: #1996 introduces a general acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header into media-range entries and correctly excludes entries with q=0 (explicitly-rejected types) and handles type/subtype wildcard matching. #2046 instead does a plain `acceptHeader.includes('application/json')` substring check, which does not honor q=0 exclusion or wildcard Accept values (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would incorrectly still be treated as accepted). #1996's helper is also reusable for the text/event-stream check in the same file, whereas #2046's fix is a one-off inline change.

members.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
members.author: Genmin
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP server in JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. Both PRs relax this validation in the same function (webStandardStreamableHttp.ts, POST handler Accept-header check) to allow JSON-only Accept headers when the transport is configured for JSON responses. (2 PRs)
